ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 15:85 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Discontinuous high-contrast white mottled clusters located in the mid-section of both lobes; left lobe contains approximately 6 distinct irregular blobs in a diagonal formation; right lobe contains a larger, more elongated cluster of contiguous white pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a 2D projected angle of approximately 85 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge from the notch to the tips, exhibiting a slight posterior sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small circular high-contrast white spots observed near the leading edge and proximal to the median notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Vertical dark linear disruptions (rake marks) observed cutting through the white pigmentation clusters on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of vertical rake marks/scars on both lobes, most distinct where they intersect the white pigmentation areas.
